name: Dreamini AI
tagline: Multi-model AI studio for image & video
description: Dreamini is a browser-based AI studio that brings leading image and video models (Seedance, Kling, PixVerse, Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image and more) into one workspace, plus a large library of photo-to-video effects and templates. Turn a photo or prompt into trending AI videos and images in minutes. Paid plans start at $9; a $199 Lifetime plan is also available.
